purpose: Canonical companion-engine runtime payload for the Fredo installer (Spec #3158). This is the single machine-readable list of payload DLL names: .opencode/scripts/stage-engine-payload.ps1 stages exactly this set and .opencode/scripts/verify-installer-payload.ps1 asserts it inside the produced installer. Hand-authored from the shipped Cargo feature set (dynamic-link, Vulkan-only, mtmd) - never scraped from a build directory.
